rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF LIBRARY HUBS IN ALL REGIONS AND SCHOOLS DIVISIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREOF
rows.status: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2011-08-02

committee_action.action: Scheduled for first meeting/hearing on 2011-03-15
Approved by the Committee on 2011-03-15
committee_action.meethigh:
Agreements reached:
â€¢Creation of a technical working group composed of Reps. Bondoc, Romualdez, Sarmiento, Tinio and DepEd Library Hub TWG to consolidate the provisions of HB Nos. 3218 and 4327
â€¢Inclusion of a provision that would clarify the books procurement process and hasten its facilitation
â€¢Preparation by the Department of Education (DepEd) Library Hub TWG of a flow chart of operations and procedures on the allocation and distribution of books
â€¢Submission of the titles of books procured

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2011-06-09
Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2011-06-28
committee_action.meethigh:
The Technical Working Group (TWG) to consolidate the provisions of House Bill nos. 3218 and 4327 re the Institutionalization of Library Hubs in all schools division held its initial meeting on June 28, 2011 at 9:30 am, Conference Room 11, RVM Building, House of Representatives, Quezon City.

Those in attendance were Reps. Anna York P. Bondoc (presiding officer), Antonio Tinio, Rogelio Espina, resource persons from the Department of Educationâ€™s (DepEd) Instructional Materials Council Secretariat, Procurement Services, Technical Working Group members of the Library Hub Project and the CBEC secretariat.

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2011-08-02
committee_action.meethigh:
To further deliberate on Measures re Libraries and the Library hub Project and consolidate the provisions of the following:

1. HB 484 - STRENGTHENING THE PROGRAM FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LIBRARIES NATIONWIDE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE RA 7743, by Rep. Angara

2. HBS 808 and 1409 â€“ AMENDMENT TO REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7743, by Reps. Palatino and Rodriguez (R), respectively

3. HB 1183 â€“ ESTABLISHMENT OF A PUBLIC LIBRARY IN EVERY PROVINCE, CITY AND MUNICIPALITY IN THE PHILIPPINES, by Rep. Villafuerte

4. HB 1223 â€“ESTABLISHMENT OF  A PUBLIC LIBRARY FOR EVERY BARANGAY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, by Rep. Arroyo (D)

5. HB 3299 â€“ESTABLISHMENT OF CITY LIBRARIES IN ALL CITY NATIONWIDE, by Rep. Lacson-Noel

6. HB 3306 â€“ ESTABLISHMENT OF BILILIHAN CONGRESSIONAL LIBRARY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BILILIHAN, PROVINCE OF BOHOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, by Rep. Relampagos

7. HB 4405 -  ESTABLISHMENT OF  SCIENCE LIBRARIES IN EVERY PROVINCE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, by Rep. Palmones

8. Substitute bill for House Bill No. 3218 by Rep. Bondoc and House Bill No. 4327 by Reps. Escudero, Bondoc, Rodriguez (R) and  Teodoro re INSTITUTIONALIZATION OF THE LIBRARY HUB

Agreements reached:
â€¢	Chair Escudero will schedule a meeting between Rep. Palatino, the Director of the National Library and the Secretary of the DepEd to discuss the problems that beset the library sector.
â€¢	Rep Palatino was designated to lead the panel of authors that would consolidate the provisions of the measures for library concerns including the Library Hub. 
â€¢	The Director of the National Library was requested to provide the Committee with a matrix of the spread of libraries in the country (number of libraries, i.e., congressional, city, municipal, and barangay).

committee_action.action: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2011-08-02
committee_action.meethigh:
â€¢	Inclusion of a provision for the creation of a Library Hub Council composed of seven (7) members: DepEd Secretary, Chairpersons of the Senate and the House of Representativesâ€™ Committees on Basic Education, Culture and Arts, Director of the National Library of the Philippines, Chairperson of the Library Hub Project, and two (2) organizations representing the private sector that is involved in reading and library program advocacy. 

â€¢	Inclusion in the DepEdâ€™s annual budget a line item particular to the Library Hub Project.

â€¢	Provide in the implementing rules and regulations (IRR) the criteria, process in the selection and evaluation of titles, and the procedure on the procurement and distribution of books.

â€¢	Provide in the IRR a provision that would balance the local and foreign content for supplementary reading materials.
